name: nca-1(gk9) — 900 s Agar Plate
description: Real nca-1(gk9) [unc-77] C. elegans recording, 900 s on agar (Zenodo 1003571, Open Worm Movement Database 2011). NCA is the NALCN-family leak channel; loss-of-function disrupts premotor circuit depolarisation, causing fainting episodes, reduced frequency and lower amplitude. Left: raw WCON skeleton (head=index 0). Right: NeuromuscularTuner 4-mode PCA eigenworm reconstruction (mu(s) + Σ aₙ(t)·eₙ(s), n=1..4), the same generative model that feeds fem_body_trace.
